summary: Iter-78 push-diagnostic + cashback cutover regression: 18/18 pytest passing on /app/backend/tests/test_iter78_push_and_cutover.py. Verified: (1) POST /api/push/test super-admin returns {ok:false, relay:'key_missing', key_configured:false, device_registration, hint} in preview and 403 for buyer/vendor; (2) POST /api/register-push returns {status:'deferred', reason:'key_missing'} (NOT 500), stamps push_registration={status,platform,at} on user doc, rejects mismatched user_id with 403; (3) chat message POST still returns 200 with a valid message doc even though the internal push relay returns 401 (send_push return-value change didn't break chat send); (4) /api/cashback-config returns max_cashback_pct=10 + delivery flat/free_threshold/cart_max; (5) MLM dead — /api/wallet/transfer 404/405, buyer /api/withdrawals 403, /api/admin/users/tree 404/405; (6) sequential IDs — POST /api/admin/short-id/backfill is idempotent (2nd call minted=0 for every kind) and GET /api/admin/short-id/TXNA1 resolves; (7) admin group-wise Excel — GET /api/admin/wallet/export/groupwise returns a real xlsx (PK zip magic + openpyxl-parseable) with 'All Transactions' sheet and a GROUP SUMMARY block, correct spreadsheetml content-type, 403 for buyer; (8) /api/admin/wallet/groupwise-summary exposes ≥15 available_groups. Frontend smoke (mobile viewport 390×844): admin can log in, navigate to /admin/broadcast which correctly renders 'Test push notification' section with 'Send test to my phone' button (testID='broadcast-test-push' present); buyer /(tabs)/wallet renders 'Your Slangcart wallet', Add money, cashback ₹ + pending ₹ chips, and NO Send/Transfer/Withdraw controls — cashback flow evidence visible in transaction list (cashback_credit + cashback_reversal rows). NOTE: task spec listed GET /api/admin/finance/export/transactions as xlsx but that endpoint still returns CSV in code — the real group-wise xlsx export lives at /api/admin/wallet/export/groupwise (which does have the 19 group sections). Reported as info, not failure.
